title: 第二十一章 小挪移阵第二十二章 地下空间
content_zh:
被抱住的同时，沐雨柔只感觉一股浓烈的男子的气息扑面而来，一时间让她的身体都有些发软。
而突如其来的一吻更是让她的心神瞬间失守，在粉色雾气的侵蚀下眼神也逐渐变得迷离起来。
沐雨柔反手将柳辰抱住，开始生疏的回应起来。
“嗯...”
一声轻呼从沐雨柔嘴中发出。
原来不知什么时候，柳辰把手伸进了沐雨柔的衣服里，抓住了她的胸部。
也正是柳辰的这一抓，让沐雨柔身体一颤，神志也渐渐清醒了过来。
醒过来的沐雨柔面对这香艳的场景以及身体传来的异样感觉，彻底失了方寸。
从未这么近距离接触过男性的她，一时竟没做出什么反应。
“啊...”
直到胸部一震疼痛感传来，沐雨柔这才反应过来发生了什么。
由于柳辰没有把控好力度，将沐雨柔给弄疼了。
羞怒至极的沐雨柔一巴掌将柳辰给拍晕了过去。
然后从空间戒指中取出一张符篆向着豪华大床轰击而去。
做完这些沐雨柔就好像全身力气被抽干一样趴在了柳辰的身上。
在符篆的攻击下，大床直接被轰的四分五裂，阵法禁制也在这一击下破碎开来，粉色雾气则在阵法破开的时候就慢慢消散了。
房间中只剩下相互抱在一起的两人，躺在地上。
等柳辰醒来时只感觉头痛欲裂，好像被人敲了一棍子一样。
刚刚醒来的他，不太清楚发生了什么，但是他记得昏迷前手上有传来柔软的触感。
“啪，啪”

就在柳辰还在揉着脑袋发呆时，他的脸上突然被人抽了两巴掌。
脸上以肉眼可见的速度肿了起来，并且有鲜红的巴掌印附着在上面。
“你...”
突然被人抽了两巴掌，柳辰也有些愤怒，当下就想骂过去。
可看到对方那寒霜般的面庞柳辰直接把到嘴的话咽了回去。
虽然有特意整理过，但是柳辰还是发现沐雨柔的头发以及服饰有些凌乱，终于柳辰想起来发生了什么。
想起了事情缘由，被扇的那两巴掌他已经不放在心上了。
他现在需要考虑的是对方会不会放过他。
“毕竟他可是抱了、亲了还抓了她的......”
想道这里他心里就不免有些忐忑，这个世界的女性还是很注重名节的，自己这么做等于是毁了对方的清白，对方不放过自己的几率很大。
“怎么，你有意见？”
见柳辰还想反抗，沐雨柔面无表情的瞪了柳辰一眼。
“么有，么有”
柳辰连连摆手否认，开玩笑，别说两巴掌，就是揍他一顿他也不敢说什么。
而且他还希望对方打他一顿，这样他的命就很大几率能保住，不会被对方灭口。
柳辰由于紧张再加上脸颊肿起来的原因，说话都有些含糊不清。
content_en:
While being hugged, Mu Yurou felt a strong man's breath rushing towards her face, which made her body feel weak for a moment.
The sudden kiss made her lose her mind instantly, and her eyes gradually became blurred under the erosion of the pink mist.
Mu Yurou hugged Liu Chen with her backhand and began to respond unfamiliarly.
"Well..."
A soft cry came from Mu Yurou's mouth.
It turned out that at some point, Liu Chen put his hand into Mu Yurou's clothes and grabbed her breasts.
It was Liu Chen's grasp that made Mu Yurou's body tremble and her mind gradually regained consciousness.
Mu Yurou, who woke up, was completely at a loss when faced with this fragrant scene and the strange feeling coming from her body.
She had never been in such close contact with a man, and she didn't react at all.
"Ah..."
It wasn't until a jolt of pain came through her chest that Mu Yurou realized what had happened.
Because Liu Chen didn't control his strength well, Mu Yurou was hurt.
Mu Yurou, who was extremely ashamed and angry, slapped Liu Chen and knocked him unconscious.
Then he took out a talisman from the space ring and struck it towards the luxurious bed.
After doing this, Mu Yurou lay on Liu Chen's body as if all her strength had been drained.
Under the attack of Fu Zhuan, the big bed was directly torn into pieces, and the formation restrictions were also shattered by this blow. The pink mist slowly dissipated when the formation was broken.
Only two people were left in the room, hugging each other and lying on the floor.
When Liu Chen woke up, he only felt a splitting headache, as if someone had hit him with a stick.
He had just woken up and was not sure what had happened, but he remembered a soft touch on his hand before he fell into coma.
"Pah, pah"
Just when Liu Chen was still rubbing his head in a daze, he was suddenly slapped twice on the face.
His face swelled up at a speed that was visible to the naked eye, and there were bright red palm prints attached to it.
"You..."
Suddenly being slapped twice, Liu Chen was a little angry and wanted to scold him immediately.
But seeing the other person's frosty face, Liu Chen swallowed back the words that came to his mouth.
Although he had tidied it up specially, Liu Chen still found that Mu Yurou's hair and clothes were a little messy, and finally Liu Chen remembered what happened.
Thinking of the reason for the incident, he no longer cared about the two slaps he received.
What he needs to consider now is whether the other party will let him go.
"After all, he hugged, kissed and caught her..."
Thinking about this, he couldn't help but feel a little uneasy. Women in this world still pay great attention to reputation. If you do this, you will ruin the innocence of the other party. There is a high chance that the other party will not let you go.
"What, you have an opinion?"
Seeing that Liu Chen still wanted to resist, Mu Yurou glared at Liu Chen expressionlessly.
"Is there, is there?"
Liu Chen waved his hands to deny it, joking, let alone slap him twice, he wouldn't dare to say anything even if he beat him up.
Moreover, he also hoped that the other party would give him a good beating, so that he would have a high chance of being saved and would not be silenced by the other party.
Liu Chen's speech was a little slurred due to nervousness and swollen cheeks.
